help_businesstypes-cherryrestaurant_cont:
**Restaurant** businesses operate out of retail buildings.

All of this store's items can be ordered from [Wholesalers](wholesalers-locations).

Customers are served by employees at the counter, then sit down to eat.

The business requires the following furniture to function:

* [Cash Register](furniture-cashregister)
* At least one product to sell (see below)

Businesses of this type primarily sell:

* [Beer](products-beer)
* [Bottle of Wine](products-bottleofwine)
* [Chicken Kabob Skewer](products-kabob)
* [Ice Cream](products-icecream)
* [Margarita](products-margarita)
* [Martini](products-martini)
* [Pizza](products-pizza)
* [Salad](products-salad)

And can additionally sell:

* [Cheese Platter](products-cheeseplatter)
* [Cupcake](products-cupcake)
* [French Fries](products-frenchfries)
* [Soda Can](products-sodacan)
* [Whisky](products-whisky)

**You have to furnish the place yourself.** There are no layout templates for this business type, so the game will neither auto-furnish it nor suggest a layout when you buy the building. In the interior designer, search for **restaurant** to find tables, chairs, booths, grills and counters.

**Seating is expected, but not required.** Tables and chairs are a customer demand, not an operating requirement - the restaurant will run without them, only with unhappy guests.

Employees with the following skills can be assigned:

* [Customer Service](skill-customerservice)
* [Cleaning](skill-cleaning)
